title: A Hierarchical Energy-Based Model for Multimodal Cognition
abstract: arXiv:2608.12398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose IM-LEPP (Integrated Multimodal Latent Energy-based Predictive Processing), a hierarchical, energy-based model of multimodal cognition that extends a previously proposed single-modality model (LEPP) to integrate vision and language. Following the view that generative neural networks are effective theories of cognitive dynamics, analogous to how statistical mechanics relates to thermodynamics, IM-LEPP models cognition as latent states flowing through learned energy landscapes rather than as an account of neural circuitry. The architecture is a hub-and-spoke hierarchy, grounded in the controlled semantic cognition framework of Lambon Ralph et al., in which predictive-coding pipelines for visual objects, scenes, and linguistic units converge on a shared amodal hub modeled on the anterior temporal lobe. translated_title: 一种用于多模态认知的层次化能量模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12398v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们提出了IM-LEPP（集成多模态潜在能量基预测处理），这是一种层次化的、基于能量的多模态认知模型，它扩展了先前提出的单模态模型（LEPP），以整合视觉和语言。遵循生成神经网络是认知动力学的有效理论这一观点，类似于统计力学与热力学的关系，IM-LEPP将认知建模为潜在状态在习得的能量景观中流动，而非对神经回路的解释。该架构是一个中心-辐射式层次结构，基于Lambon Ralph等人的受控语义认知框架，其中用于视觉对象、场景和语言单元的预测编码管道汇聚到一个共享的非模态中心，该中心模拟前颞叶。每个管道自身的预测由当前中心状态条件化，而非被覆盖，从而保留管道特定性。
tldr: 本文提出IM-LEPP，一种层次化能量基多模态认知模型，通过中心-辐射架构整合视觉和语言，利用共享非模态中心条件化各管道预测，以模拟认知状态流动。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes IM-LEPP, a hierarchical energy-based model for multimodal cognition that integrates vision and language via a hub-and-spoke architecture, conditioning pipeline-specific predictions on a shared amodal hub.
